Adds Euro Office as a first-class web-office option.

## Added

- **Euro Office in the "Web office suite" dropdown.** The sovereign OnlyOffice fork (image `ghcr.io/euro-office/documentserver`) is now its own choice next to `collabora` and `onlyoffice`. Pick `euro-office`, run the document server as a separate container, and OpenCloud wires it up: it is driven as the OnlyOffice product with the display name "Euro-Office" and WOPI proof-key verification disabled, matching OpenCloud's own euro-office example. A one-click Unraid template for the Euro Office document server is available in the junkerderprovinz feed. OpenCloud makes Euro Office the default editor for the MS Office formats.

## Notes

- For OnlyOffice and Euro Office, the "Office WOPI secret" must equal the document server's JWT secret (`JWT_SECRET` / `EURO_OFFICE_JWT_SECRET`). For Collabora it is not required.
